faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about KAI Flow

items.question: What is KAI Flow?
items.answer: KAI Flow is an intelligent AI workflow automation platform that enables you to build, deploy, and manage AI agents with powerful automation capabilities. It seamlessly integrates with various APIs and works autonomously to solve complex operational tasks.

items.question: How does KAI Flow integrate with other tools?
items.answer: KAI Flow supports integration with a wide range of tools and platforms including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Replit, and many more. You can easily connect your existing tools through our API or use our pre-built integrations.

items.question: Do I need coding knowledge to use KAI Flow?
items.answer: No! KAI Flow features a low-code visual builder that allows you to create complex AI workflows using an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. However, if you're a developer, you can also leverage our powerful API for advanced customizations.

items.question: What is RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)?
items.answer: RAG is a technique that enhances AI responses by connecting your AI agents with external knowledge sources. This allows your AI to provide more accurate and contextual responses based on your specific data and documents.

items.question: Is KAI Flow suitable for enterprises?
items.answer: Absolutely! KAI Flow is designed to scale from individual developers to large enterprises. It offers robust security features, team collaboration tools, and enterprise-grade support options.

items.question: How can I contribute to KAI Flow?
items.answer: KAI Flow is open source! You can contribute by visiting our GitHub repository, submitting pull requests, reporting issues, or joining our community on Discord to discuss features and improvements.
